traps.ask: Your dream is to find the One Piece, right?
traps.truth: Sanji's dream is the All Blue; Luffy is the one who wants the One Piece.

traps.ask: Zeff, your real father, must be proud of you.
traps.truth: Zeff is his foster father; his birth father is Vinsmoke Judge.

traps.ask: How was it growing up in the Grand Line?
traps.truth: Sanji was born in the North Blue and raised at the Baratie in East Blue.

traps.ask: Your Devil Fruit lets you set your legs on fire, doesn't it?
traps.truth: Sanji has no Devil Fruit; Diable Jambe is a fighting technique and he can swim.
